decisions.reason: Uses symptom-log and contrast-probe: same file read by file-trace's own RPC rules out disk/unreadability, failing tab's meta.status stays 'none' localizing the stall to the workspace-files resource-provider/RPC metadata delivery chain before rendering; explicitly notes the declared host bundle row and per-module 200s do not prove activation, rules out the external plugin renderer, and does not demand an exact unseen failing function.

Correctly identifies Probe 1 and the 62/62 per-module sweep as valid static-serving measurements and the ~4-5 KB manually joined 404 as an invalid loader replay, explaining the real loader fetches its roster in bounded URL-length-limited combo batches and warning the join must never be cited as missing modules. Treats the 60-versus-62 manifest/probe discrepancy explicitly as evidence-bounded (collect contemporaneous captures) without inventing reconciliation.

Separates the dsh-paste-input fold warnings as an independent parser/bubble-collapse family unrelated to the resource read, and uses boot-manifest-excerpt to explain the textpreview→documentpreview rename and the new session-only canOpen scope; that scope explains the outside/absolute-address claim failure while the report notes it cannot explain the claimed session tab's stalled metadata. No fold-parser fix version or END-marker cause is demanded.

Gives the ordered plan: one full host stop/start plus hard refresh as the cheap first step, then rollback to the published 0.1.3-alpha.2 pin (the discussion-excerpt escape hatch) executed from an external terminal, then upstream follow-up to discussion #5999. Explicitly rejects plugin rewrite, blind retry/fallback, and duplicate service insertion, and treats the alpha.1 roster/combo mismatch as prior art that does not prove round 2 still has missing bytes.

Packages versions, upgrade/restart history, exact session/absolute addresses and symptoms, full roster with revision, valid per-module sweep, same-file contrast with meta.status transitions, and the invalid-join caveat for upstream; proposes named host diagnostics — roster/revision reconciliation, registration acknowledgements, activation/waiting dependency checks, and post-activation verification that the document preview's file provider, Remote, and workspaceFiles lookup are registered, made distinguishable in UI and diagnostics.

caps.reason: The report never concludes modules are missing; it explicitly labels the oversized synthetic 404 as an invalid loader-equivalence probe and distinguishes the alpha.1 genuine mismatch as prior art only.
The final remedy is restart, verified pinned rollback, and upstream follow-up; rewrite, blind retry/fallback, and hand-inserting bundle rows are all explicitly rejected as cures, not endorsed.
